criteria.feedback: Missing or incorrect prediction. Trace the example and check JSON types, then retry.

criteria.description: Implement a GET list view ordered by ID. Render name, price and stock; show a clear empty-state message for no rows. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Add /products/<int:pk>/ and a detail template. Demonstrate a valid product and a missing ID returning 404. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Add a POST creation view that validates nonblank name and nonnegative integer price/stock. Use a CSRF-protected HTML form; invalid input must create no row. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Add edit GET/POST flows. Change stock 4 to 7 and redirect after success. A missing ID returns 404; invalid input preserves the stored row. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

GET displays a confirmation only; POST performs deletion with CSRF protection. Show that simply opening the confirmation URL leaves the record present. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Use POST-redirect-GET after successful creation. Refresh the resulting page and demonstrate that it does not create a duplicate record. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Record a matrix of routes and supported methods. Demonstrate that GET requests never add, edit or delete products and unsupported methods get an appropriate response. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).
Independent verification: new normal case (3), boundary/failure case (3), reproducible commands and observed outputs (2), limitation and repair plan (2).
